symptom: After record handoff, cancellation or supersession of a final checkpoint prevented later stop/delete directives from reaching the engine. An immutable writer seal also caused replacement final capture to fail before it could reuse the frozen database pair.
rule: Keep authenticated final-checkpoint control separate from record-write and workload admission. Retry only the original current writer, retain irreversible admission fences, reconcile exact cancellation first, and never reopen sealed NORMAL storage.
